title: Fortune Of Pillars
description: This is the classic cubecraft Fortune Of Pillars
body:
This plugin recreates the classic CubeCraft, Pillars Of Fortune

Players start on bedrock pillars and every 5 secs, players are given a random item with the goal eliminating the other players

COMMANDS:

/POF setup

This command sets blocks in a three chunk radius of the player who typed the command to air. Additonally it creates 4 bedrock pillars at y-60 in the chunk the player typed the command.

/POF start

This command start the Pillars of Fortune game. It's important that the command is entered in the chunk of the bedrock pillars because it teleports up to 4 players on at y-70 which is the top of bedrock pillars.

/POF stop

This command stops giving players random items

This plugin supports up to

**2-4 Players**


To **START** the game do the following commands

/POF setup

In the chunk that the bedrock pillars are in use 

/POF start



To **RESTART** the game:

/POF stop

In the orignal chunk with the bedrock pillars

/POF setup

In the orignal chunk with the bedrock pillars

/POF start
